!Series_title = Single cell RNA sequencing analysis of P63+ lung progenitor cells isolated from IPF patients
!Series_summary = To gain molecular insights into the identity composition of the cells selectively grown in the culture system, we performed single-cell sequencing on the primary cell.

!Series_overall_design = After removing feeder cells through gradient digestion, the primary cells isolated by the pharmaceutical-grade cell cloning culture system were digested to prepare a single-cell suspension.
